title: Add soft-delete support to Order model
description: Orders are currently hard-deleted, which breaks downstream reporting and makes it impossible to investigate customer disputes after the fact. Add soft-delete behaviour to the Order model so that deleted orders are excluded from default querysets but remain in the database for audit purposes.

comments.author: lin
comments.text: Went with a custom manager overriding get_queryset() rather than a third-party package, since we only needed the one behaviour and wanted to avoid the extra dependency.

comments.author: reviewer
comments.text: Please add a migration to backfill deleted_at as NULL for existing rows and add an index on it since we'll filter on it constantly.

implementation_notes: Added a `deleted_at` nullable timestamp column with a partial index (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) to keep the default queryset fast. Added SoftDeleteManager and SoftDeleteQuerySet with a `.all_with_deleted()` escape hatch for admin/reporting code.
resolution: Merged. Default Order.objects excludes soft-deleted rows; Order.all_objects gives full access. Existing hard-delete call sites in the refunds flow were updated to call .delete() which now sets deleted_at instead of removing the row.
